record.short: Synthesia adds a Business plan at $99/month between Pro and Enterprise, and survey responses drop from 350 to 100 credits.
record.headline: Synthesia introduced a Business plan at $99 per month, with up to 10 editors and a shared credit pool, and Enterprise now builds on it.
record.who: Teams needing more than one editor; Pro and Enterprise buyers now see Business as the step between them.
record.read: The new tier fills the gap between single-seat Pro and custom Enterprise pricing, giving multi-seat teams a self-serve price. The cheaper survey credit rate lowers usage cost for survey users.
record.caveat: Page also restructures the credit display (yearly plans quoted per year) and the API section; only the headline changes are listed here.
